summary: Full backend+frontend test of new /consulting-12 'AI Opportunity Canvas' route. 4/4 backend pytest cases pass. All 25+ frontend assertions (desktop + mobile) pass. One real production write created with 'TEST - please delete' marker as instructed.

issues: Thank-you headline wraps very narrowly (approx 6-9 chars per line) because it renders inside the narrower main column while the left intro title column is empty. Minor polish item — not a functional blocker. Consider widening the success block to span the full canvas width or horizontally centre it.

action_items: (Optional) Improve success-state layout width on desktop so the thank-you headline doesn't wrap in a narrow column.
critical_code_review_comments: Consulting12.jsx uses window.location.origin for API base instead of process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Works in production (same origin) but deviates from the stated environment convention and would break if frontend/backend are split.
Backend security gateway requires /api/form-context handshake + >=0.5s wait before public POSTs — the frontend handles this correctly via formTransport.js. Documented here for future testers.
seed_data_creation: 1 production contact_us submission with firstName='UI Tester' (name field used 'UI Tester'), formVariant='consulting-12', message prefixed 'TEST - please delete'. Email: test-c12-ui-<random>@example.com. 1 backend pytest submission: test-c12-<random>@example.com message 'TEST - please delete. Consulting-12 pytest submission.' Please delete both.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public form POSTs on this backend require X-BB-Form-Token header + session cookie from GET /api/form-context, with >=0.5s delay (min_age). See /app/backend/tests/test_consulting12.py 'session' fixture. SPA GET routes return HTTP 404 at ingress but serve HTML — use the UI (Playwright) to assert route rendering rather than requests.get status codes. HIDE_FORM_PATHS now includes /consulting-10, /consulting-11, /consulting-12. ContactSubmission.formVariant Literal includes consulting-6..12 and lastName is optional for those variants.
